title: 第11章 离别第12章 初遇超凡者
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
春日的午后，二月的微风轻拂，阳光透过斑驳的树叶，洒落在四合院的庭院里。
林道悠然地躺在，一张舒适的躺椅上，身上披着一层柔和的金光。
他微微眯起双眼，尽情地沐浴在这温暖的阳光下，脸上洋溢着无比惬意的神情。
然而，看似悠闲的林道其实暗藏玄机。
虽然表面上他只是静静地躺着，但实际上，以他为中心方圆一百米范围内，的一切动静，都无法逃脱他敏锐的感知。
原来，此时的林道正开启“见闻色霸气”，让他能够洞察周围环境中的细微变化，仿佛拥有了一双无形的眼睛。
而想要让见闻色霸气成长，就必须持续不断地开启它，并通过日复一日的，锻炼来提升其熟练度。
经过长时间的修炼，如今林道的见闻色霸气，已经达到了初级顶峰的水平。
凭借着这一强大的能力，他不仅可以轻易地感知到，他人的实力强弱以及情绪，还能够准确地判断出，视野之外敌人的数量和具体位置。
追求更高境界的林道来说，这还远远不够。
他深知，突破至中级见闻色霸气，见闻色霸气覆盖范围变得更大，更能提前预测敌人攻击，让自己拥有先发制敌的先机。
按照他目前的进展速度来看，距离这个目标的达成应该不会太久了。
就在这时，原本安静在躺椅上的林道，忽然眉头微微一挑，嘴角也不自觉地上扬起来。
似乎是察觉到了什么，让他心情舒畅的事。
果然，没过多久，一阵由远及近的电动摩托车轰鸣声从门外传了进来。
人未到声已至，“小破孩，快开门，姐姐给你带好东西来的了。”
赵诗涵美眸明媚，嘴角含笑，纤纤玉手轻轻叩着大门。
林道懒得动，而是右手一抓，一枚石子飞入手中，屈指一弹，石子“咻”着一声，化作流光，掠过空间，只听“嘭”打落门闩。
林道躺在躺椅上，懒洋洋道：“门没锁，诗涵姐你自己进来吧！”
很快，赵诗涵双手提两个黑色袋子，走进院中，看着林道懒散的模样，不由得翻了个好看白眼。

“我这里有个消息，你一定想听，但我不告诉你！”赵诗涵脚步轻快，走进林道家厨房里。
林道表情一愣，皱眉道：“什么消息？”
赵诗涵从厨房探出脑袋：“想知道，过来帮你姐我打下手。”
林道不由起身，一脸无奈的走向厨房，看着赵诗涵从黑色袋子里，拿出各式各样肉类。
林道不由喉咙滚动了一下，来到赵诗涵身旁，接过递过来各式肉类。
林道问道：“说吧！是什么事情。”
赵诗涵停下手中的活，呼出一口气：“前天被你打得很惨的四人还记得吗？”
林道手一顿，微眯起眼睛：“怎么他们派人找你麻烦呢！”
其实这件事他处理有些粗糙了，应该将这帮家伙直接物理毁灭。
现在有些隐患，自己倒不怕，但诗涵姐一家人居住在乌林镇，想到这林道眼中闪过一抹杀意。
“当然不是，我听说那四人，被送到医院后，不久之后就死了。”赵诗涵俏脸古怪的道。
“不可能，出手时我留了分寸，顶多就残废。”林道肯定道。
赵诗涵表情轻快道：“那四个混蛋，送进医院，就发生医疗事故，当场领了盒饭。”
林道神情一愣，有些出乎他预料，然后回过神，与赵诗涵对视一眼。
在厨房忙碌完后，赵诗涵吩咐，林道把烤架搬到院中。
而她自己来到摆放，林道父母遗像房间里，点燃三根香，恭敬的上完香，眼神温柔看着院中忙碌的少年。
content_en:
On a spring afternoon, the February breeze blew gently, and the sunlight filtered through the mottled leaves and fell on the courtyard of the courtyard.
Lin Dao was lying leisurely on a comfortable lounge chair, his body covered with a layer of soft golden light.
He narrowed his eyes slightly and bathed in the warm sunshine, with an extremely comfortable look on his face.
However, the seemingly leisurely Lin Dao actually hides a secret.
Although on the surface he was just lying quietly, in fact, all movements within a radius of one hundred meters with him as the center could not escape his keen perception.
It turned out that at this time, Lin Dao was turning on the "Seeing and Hearing Color Haki", which allowed him to observe subtle changes in the surrounding environment, as if he had a pair of invisible eyes.
And if you want to grow the domineering power of knowledge, you must continue to turn it on and improve its proficiency through daily exercise.
After a long period of practice, Lin Dao's power of knowledge and color has now reached the level of the primary peak.
With this powerful ability, he can not only easily sense the strength and emotions of others, but also accurately determine the number and specific location of enemies outside his field of vision.
For Lindao who pursues a higher realm, this is not enough.
He knew very well that by breaking through to the intermediate level of knowledge and knowledge, the coverage of knowledge and color Haki would become larger, and he would be able to predict enemy attacks in advance, giving himself the opportunity to defeat the enemy first.
Judging from his current progress rate, it shouldn't be too long before this goal is achieved.
At this moment, Lin Dao, who was quietly sitting on the recliner, suddenly raised his eyebrows slightly and the corners of his mouth unconsciously raised.
He seemed to have noticed something that made him feel good.
Sure enough, not long after, a distant roar of an electric motorcycle came from outside the door.
The voice came before anyone arrived, "Little bastard, open the door quickly, my sister has brought you something good."
Zhao Shihan's beautiful eyes were bright, with a smile on her lips, and her slender hands gently knocked on the door.
Lin Dao was too lazy to move, but grabbed it with his right hand, and a stone flew into his hand. With a flick of his finger, the stone turned into a stream of light with a "whoosh" sound, passing through the space, and only heard a "bang" knocking down the door latch.
Lin Dao lay on the recliner and said lazily: "The door is unlocked. Sister Shihan, please come in by yourself!"
Soon, Zhao Shihan walked into the courtyard with two black bags in both hands. Looking at Lin Dao's lazy appearance, he couldn't help but roll his eyes.
"I have news here that you must want to hear, but I won't tell you!" Zhao Shihan walked briskly into the kitchen of Lin Dao's house.
Lindao looked stunned, frowned and said, "What news?"
Zhao Shihan poked her head out of the kitchen: "If you want to know, come over and help your sister."
Lin Dao couldn't help but get up and walked to the kitchen helplessly, watching Zhao Shihan take out all kinds of meat from the black bag.
Lin Dao couldn't help but his throat rolled, and he came to Zhao Shihan's side and took over all kinds of meat.
Lindao asked: "Tell me! What is it?"
Zhao Shihan stopped what she was doing and exhaled: "Do you still remember the four people who were beaten badly by you the day before yesterday?"
Lin Dao paused and narrowed his eyes slightly: "Why did they send people to trouble you?"
In fact, his handling of this matter was a bit rough, and these guys should be directly physically destroyed.
There are some hidden dangers now, but I am not afraid of them, but Sister Shihan's family lives in Wulin Town, and a murderous intention flashed in Lin Dao's eyes when he thought of this.
"Of course not. I heard that those four people died soon after they were sent to the hospital." Zhao Shihan said with a strange face.
"It's impossible. I was cautious when I took action. At most, I would be disabled." Lin Dao affirmed.
Zhao Shihan said with a brisk expression: "Those four bastards had a medical accident when they were sent to the hospital. They received boxed lunches on the spot."
Lin Dao was stunned for a moment, which was a bit beyond his expectation, then he came back to his senses and looked at Zhao Shihan.
After finishing busy in the kitchen, Zhao Shihan ordered, Lindao moved the grill to the courtyard.
And she herself came to the room where the portraits of Lin Dao's parents were placed, lit three incense sticks, and finished the incense respectfully, looking at the busy young man in the courtyard with gentle eyes.
